claim: QA round 11 R11-01: registerRestaurant folds the owner's address with normalizeEmail before it checks for an existing account and before it inserts the users row, so an owner who registers as Chef@Bistro.com is stored as chef@bistro.com and every lookup door (reset, emailed code, Google, sign-in-methods) finds them; migration a_sign_in_address_is_kept_in_lower_case folds earlier public.users rows and never merges a case-collision
verify: awk '/async registerRestaurant\(dto: RegisterRestaurantDto\)/,/emailAlreadyRegistered/' apps/api-gateway/src/auth/auth.service.ts | grep -q 'const email = normalizeEmail(dto.email);' && awk '/async registerRestaurant\(dto: RegisterRestaurantDto\)/,/email_verified: false/' apps/api-gateway/src/auth/auth.service.ts | grep -qE '^          email,$' && ls supabase/migrations/ | grep -q '_a_sign_in_address_is_kept_in_lower_case.sql$'
